notes: Employees: the report's group headline figure, 'Total workforce: 16,447' (repeated in the Human Capital section as 'Group total workforce'), for FY26; the report does not print a date for it, so it is taken as at the March 31, 2026 year end. It covers Biocon Limited, Biocon Biologics and Syngene; whether it includes contract workers is not stated (the report's women-representation figure is described as 'excluding contractors'). Biocon Limited alone had 3,269 permanent employees at March 31, 2026 (Board's report). Payroll: consolidated employee benefits expense of ₹35,080 million for FY26, which includes ₹1,639 million of share-based compensation; R&D staff costs (₹2,269 million in note 29) are in this line.
